# required-files.txt — RedRoomRewards canonical-doc pins
#
# Consumed by scripts/classify-docs.js: every *.md entry here is pinned
# CANONICAL (source of truth) and is therefore NEVER an archival candidate for
# the reports-scope pass (scripts/archive-historical-docs.js). This is the
# kit-native way to protect a live doc whose *name* would otherwise trip the
# HISTORICAL report-name heuristic (e.g. STATUS_PAGE_TEMPLATES.md is a live
# incident-comms template, not a spent "STATUS" report).
#
# SEED FOR CEO RATIFICATION. This list was curated during the doc-kit install
# from the live doc corpus; it is deliberately conservative (specs, contracts,
# runbooks, and standing references only — no point-in-time reports). The CEO
# may extend or trim it. The governing charter itself is RRR-GOV-002; this file
# governs doc classification only, not code.
#
# One repo-relative path per line. Blank lines and #-comments are ignored.
